title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent single‑mic audience capture of a laid‑back show highlighted by a Dark Star with a hint of the “Feelin’ Groovy” vibe.
ai_review.review: The tape, sourced from one microphone in the audience, is remarkably clean and crisp, delivering an immersive listening experience. The performance is relaxed, with Tom Constanten’s keyboards adding flavor and a Dark Star that carries some of the groovy feel of the famed 11‑02 show, though it never quite reaches that level of development.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive feedback on recording quality (excellent audience tape) and generally favorable comments on the show, tempered by a moderate rating for the Dark Star’s development.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with a single microphone; surprisingly clear and balanced with minimal ambient noise, delivering crisp detail throughout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, laid‑back set that flows smoothly; the Dark Star offers a glimpse of the 'Feelin' Groovy' energy from later shows but feels less fully realized.

band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten's playing is praised as a great addition to the performance.
